title: Bear's Sleepy Colors
lesson: Slowing down and settling to sleep
summary: Bear cannot settle at sunset, so Duck and Owl help him name the colors of the evening, from orange sky to blue night, until he is sleepy in his bed.

steps.say: The sun is going down. Bear is not sleepy at all.

steps.text: Grr. I am wide awake. I cannot stop wiggling.

steps.say: Duck waddles over to see him.

steps.text: Quack. Bear, look at the sky. What color is the sun?
The sun is orange, like a carrot.

steps.say: Orange. Can you say orange with Bear?

steps.text: Yes! Orange is a warm, slow color. Let us find more.

steps.say: Bear and Duck tiptoe into the garden.

steps.text: Quack. Look at this flower. What color is it?
It is pink. Pink and soft.

steps.say: A second flower opens. Its petals are purple.

steps.text: Pink, and purple. Two sleepy flowers.

steps.say: Can you count the flowers with Bear? One, two.

steps.text: Even the flowers are closing. They are going to bed.
Yawn. Maybe I feel a little sleepy.

steps.say: Next, they stroll to the quiet pond. The sky is getting darker.

steps.text: Quack. The water is blue. Blue, like the evening.
Blue is cool and calm. Blue, blue, blue.

steps.say: A yellow star twinkles above the water.

steps.text: Yellow! The star is yellow. Oh, look, my feet are orange!
Orange, pink, purple, blue, and yellow. That is five colors.

steps.say: Can you count five colors with Bear?
In the dark forest, a soft voice goes hoo, hoo.

steps.text: Hoo, hoo. Why are you two up so late?
I was not sleepy. So we named the colors.
Hoo, lovely. Now what color is the night?
The night is a deep, dark blue. Quack.
Yes. When the world turns dark blue, it is time to sleep.
Yawn. I think I am ready now.

steps.say: Fireflies glow in the night. They are green and gold.

steps.text: Quack. Green and gold. That is seven colors.

steps.say: Orange, pink, purple, blue, yellow, green and gold. Say them slowly.

steps.text: Hoo. A good bear counts colors, not sheep.
Yawn. Let us walk home together.

steps.say: They walk slowly, step by sleepy step.
At home, Bear climbs into his cozy bed.

steps.text: Quack. Goodnight, Bear. Sweet dreams of colors.
Goodnight, Duck. Goodnight, orange, pink and blue.

steps.say: Bear snuggles down under his blanket. The moon is yellow and soft.
Shhh. Bear is fast asleep. Sleep tight, little one.
